lines.en: Desert sand burns under my feet.
Sand pours into the seams of my armour.
One step, then another, toward the tomb gate.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙，我走了几千年。
lines.en: I have walked this desert sand for ages.
Don't look back. The tomb gate is behind you.
Will anyone wait at the tomb gate?

lines.zh: 这条路通向沙漠下的坟墓。
lines.en: This road leads to tombs beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 日头压下来，我往沙影里走。
lines.en: The sun bears down; I walk in the dune's shadow.

lines.zh: 这双腿太久没走过路了。
lines.en: These legs haven't walked in a long time.

lines.zh: 这条商路，我送过许多亡魂。
lines.en: I've walked many souls down this trade road.
The wind blows past. I feel no cold.
My home lies buried beneath the sand.
A wail in the wind? Only wind.
I forgot to weigh your heart.

lines.zh: 我召来的骷髅，戴着金饰。
lines.en: The skeletons I call wear gold.
So quiet the sand has no wind.

lines.zh: 沙子下面，我已经站了很久。
lines.en: I've stood under this sand a long time.
Who lit the lamp in the tomb?
The fiercest sun can't dry me out.
My jackal head bakes in the sand.
I can stand guard until the dunes move.

lines.zh: 名字埋得太久，记不清了。
lines.en: My name was buried too long to recall.
The heart in your chest is beating loud.
A living one, still warm.
Don't fear. I'm only weighing your heart.
Come closer. My eyes are failing.
Don't run. You can't run out of the sand.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，借我掂量一下。
lines.en: Lend me your eyes to weigh.

lines.zh: 沙漠的风，把我的金饰磨亮了。
lines.en: Desert wind polished my gold.
Do you know this jackal face?
I'm not hungry. My belly emptied long ago.

lines.zh: 他们叫我阿努比斯，记住。
lines.en: They call me Anubis. Remember.

lines.zh: 沙里招来的骷髅，还没站好。
lines.en: The skeletons I called from the sand are still rising.
Did you hear that click?

lines.zh: 这具身体经不起第二下。
lines.en: This body won't take a second blow.
Pain. So I still have feeling.
Back off. One warning only.
A crack runs through my bone.
This jackal head isn't merely decoration.
The bones still hang together. Again.
My jackal head knows the guilty.
The blows I took alive were heavier.
Two skeletons rise to shield me.

lines.zh: 这东西，天平称不出分量。
lines.en: The scales find no weight in this.
Bones. Best when freshly picked.

lines.zh: 金子在叫我，我的手不听。
lines.en: Gold is calling, and my hands won't obey.
Hunger is sand with no bottom.
Set it down and go. I want only a little.

lines.zh: 就一口，我保证不动那本书。
lines.en: One bite, I promise not to touch the book.
I clench my jaw and my bones creak.
That meat is still steaming.

lines.zh: 饥饿刻在骨头里，擦不掉。
lines.en: Hunger is carved into my bones.
My jackal head lowers to look at you.

lines.zh: 肩骨掉在沙上，我自己捡。
lines.en: My shoulder bone fell in the sand; I'll pick it up.

lines.zh: 离我远点，你的热气太冲。
lines.en: Stay back. Your heat is too much.

lines.zh: 我叫来的骷髅，都戴着金饰。
lines.en: The skeletons I summon all wear gold.
The sand is too soft; I can't stand firm.
One of my ribs gave a crack.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气烫到我了。
lines.en: The heat of you burns me.
One bump and sand falls off my shoulder.
I've cleared the way.

lines.zh: 我叫出的骷髅，戴着金饰。
lines.en: The skeletons I call wear gold.
Don't come closer. Our shadows would overlap.

lines.zh: 我举着金杖从沙里站起。
lines.en: I rise from the sand with a golden staff.
The living leave. I stay in the sand.
Only dry sand is left in my chest.

lines.zh: 指环会从骨节上滑下去。
lines.en: A ring would slide off these joints.
Half a tomb, kept for you.

lines.zh: 阴影里站着的，只有我们。
lines.en: Only we stand in the shadow.

lines.zh: 在你身边，沙子也不那么烫。
lines.en: Beside you, even the sand feels cooler.
By moonlight, my word holds.
That thought should have been buried with me.
Gold nuggets mean little in my hand.
I saw this thing while I still lived.
What I dig out of the sand is mine.
Anything that gleams belongs to me.
Back into the sand. Bury it well.
Something in my hand makes me feel alive.
My pocket is torn; the sand leaks out.
I wore gold like this in life.

lines.zh: 这块金粒，我要收进宝盒。
lines.en: This gold nugget goes into my box.
My knuckles are too stiff to grip.
We'll walk slowly to the scales.
Catching you is a few paces of sand.
Don't fear. Judgment is swift.

lines.zh: 活人的气味，从沙里渗出来。
lines.en: The smell of the living seeps through the sand.
Under the gold mask — don't move.
Living one, halt your steps.

lines.zh: 我在这片沙里等了很久。
lines.en: I've waited long in this sand.
Your heartbeat is louder than a drum.

lines.zh: 我的骷髅仆从，戴着头饰。
lines.en: My skeletons come adorned.
You shouldn't meddle with the sand tomb.

lines.zh: 沙漠的太阳，照不进我的眼睛。
lines.en: The desert sun can't reach my eyes.

lines.zh: 我召来的两具骷髅，已经站起来了。
lines.en: The two skeletons I called are already standing.

lines.zh: 沙漠的风把沙子吹进你眼睛。
lines.en: Desert wind blows sand in your eyes.

lines.zh: 沙漠的金沙，盖着我的肩。
lines.en: Desert gold dust covers my shoulders.
You. Step up to the scales.
My skeletal guards — come forth.
The scent on you is heavy.
I've chased you from oasis to dune.

lines.zh: 沙丘那边没有别的出口。
lines.en: There's no other way off the dune.
Break my legs and I'll crawl after you.
Don't hide in the light. It's hotter there.
Desert sand weighs you for me.
The scales have already tipped my way.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙烫脚，我照样追。
lines.en: Desert sand burns; I still chase.

lines.zh: 你的影子印在沙上，很清楚。
lines.en: Your shadow prints clearly on the sand.
I'm in no hurry. You'll run out of breath.
Wait for me. One step won't matter.

lines.zh: 沙把耳朵磨得比狗还灵。
lines.en: The sand has sharpened my ears past a jackal's.

lines.zh: 天平的一端，已经压下去了。
lines.en: One side of the scale has already sunk.

lines.zh: 我叫来的骷髅，戴着金饰。
lines.en: The skeletons I call wear gold.

lines.zh: 你那口气，我数得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I can count every breath you take.
The sand deepens as you run. You'll tire.
I see the sweat on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 权杖落空，沙里留下一个坑。
lines.en: My staff misses and leaves a pit in the sand.

lines.zh: 我这两只戴头饰的骷髅，替我出手。
lines.en: Two crested skeletons strike for me.
One more. Don't fall yet.
Here. Take this staff.

lines.zh: 我的权杖落地，沙子都跳了。
lines.en: My staff struck the sand and it jumped.
Don't dodge. Stand under my staff.
This time the staff struck true.
This jackal head has judged too many.

lines.zh: 两根骨头，替我挡在前面。
lines.en: Two skeletons stand before me.
Step aside, my road runs over sand.

lines.zh: 这副身体只剩审判的用处。
lines.en: This body is only good for judgment now.

lines.zh: 我召来的骷髅，戴着头饰。
lines.en: The skeletons I call wear headdress.
My staff tip pries your shoulder plate open.
See? These old bones still serve.

lines.zh: 戴头饰的骷髅，正在起来。
lines.en: The adorned skeletons are rising.

lines.zh: 擦到了，可惜，镰刀差一寸。
lines.en: A graze, a pity, my khopesh missed by an inch.
I've walked back from beneath the dune.
Stand back, living. This place belongs to the dead.

lines.zh: 沙丘裂开，我提着权杖上来。
lines.en: The dune splits; I rise with my staff.
The light is too bright. My eyes sting.
The sand underfoot is all too familiar.
Don't light a lamp. I need no light.

lines.zh: 墓门开着，谁在里面点灯。
lines.en: The tomb door is open - who lit a lamp inside?
Darkness is welcome. It hides the sun.
I raise my staff and the sand flows.
shadows... back again.

lines.zh: 这地方，和我记得的不同。
lines.en: This place is not as I remember.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，两只骷髅就站起来。
lines.en: One gesture and two skeletons rise.
The sand loosened. I'm out.
This sky over the sand — I remember it.
Fire would burn me. I'll put it out.
Falling, I counted to three.
Water fills my chest. It's heavy.

lines.zh: 我的金饰被炸得叮当响。
lines.en: The blast set my gold ornaments ringing.

lines.zh: 又是箭，你们只会这一招。
lines.en: Arrows again. It's your only trick.

lines.zh: 魔法进了骨头缝，我站不稳。
lines.en: Magic reached my bone joints; I cannot stand firm.
Sand fills my gut and I grow emptier.
The lightning knocked my headdress askew.

lines.zh: 连沙子都没有，只有虚空。
lines.en: Not even sand, only the void.
